WHAT WE DO
Looking for a creative and functional website? We recommend the right technology for your business — easy to scale, fast and optimised for search engines — and design every website around your brand.
High-impact landing pages built to capture leads and maximise ROI — focused on one campaign and one action: a sign-up, a form submission or a call.
A professional corporate website that reflects your brand identity and values — any number of pages, easy to navigate and optimised for every device.
See your website before it goes live. We design a functional UI/UX with a smooth user flow, so you can experience the finished site before development.
Shopify and WooCommerce online stores designed and developed to sell — secure checkout, payment gateways and product pages optimised for search.

Custom design, no templates
Every website is designed from scratch around your logo, colours and brand identity.

Fixed, transparent pricing
A clear quote before we start — no hidden costs and no surprise invoices.

Built to generate enquiries
Clear calls-to-action, WhatsApp and lead forms that turn visitors into customers.

Full ownership & source code
On completion you receive the website, source code, content and a full backup.

Ongoing support
We stay available after launch for updates, fixes and improvements.

Our website packages start from AED 899 for a one-page Starter website and go up to AED 3,999 for a complete e-commerce website. Every package is fixed-price; custom or enterprise projects are quoted after we understand your requirements.
Will I receive full ownership of my website?
Yes. On completion you receive 100% ownership — the design, source code, content, any custom plugins and a full backup are handed over to you.
Free website hosting server for the first year is included in the Business, Growth and E-Commerce packages. For the Starter package we can set up hosting for you or deploy to your existing hosting.
Custom web design for businesses across Dubai & the UAE. Hee&Lee is a professional website design company delivering fast, beautiful, and results-driven websites.
